name: Asahi
message: 「Haa, hah... hah, hah...」
I wipe away the flowing sweat and lift my face. A cool night breeze steals the heat from my flushed body.

name: Asahi
message: 「Still... not enough. I have to train more...」
I clench my fists while steadying my breathing.
I’ve been receiving support from Iori-sensei on the technical side, and I’ve been steadily seeing results.
Despite that, the impatience within me won't settle.

name: Asahi
message: （At this snail's pace, I'll never be able to catch up to Momiji-san or Victoria-san...！）
It's midnight, well past my bedtime. I look up, and the light in Momiji-san’s room is still on.

name: Asahi
message: （...Momiji-san is staying up late again, huh? Well, I'm one to talk...）
Iori-sensei has told me to make sure I rest. But I haven't been able to bring myself to follow that.

name: Asahi
message: 「The only way for me to beat everyone else is to keep training.」
Coming to this academy, I learned that my talent isn't anything special. There’s always someone better... that's what was drilled into me.
I don’t have innate talent like Momiji-san.
I don’t have overwhelming psychometric sensitivity like Victoria-san.
And I don't have a special Tenju like Ririmu-san.

name: Asahi
message: （If I can't catch up with talent, I have no choice but to work hard...）
But is this way of training really enough?
Thanks to Iori-sensei’s guidance, I’ve started to learn an aggressive stance bit by bit, but the anxiety never ends.

name: Asahi
message: （...That's right, I should consult with Sensei once more. There must be a better way.）
I nod to myself and head toward the dormitory entrance. It’s a little earlier than usual, but I’ll call it a night for today.
Beyond the entrance light, I felt someone's presence.
The one who arrived was... Arakawa Sonomi-san.
I’d only seen her once before while she was with Setsugekka-san, but the perilous atmosphere she carried was unforgettable.

name: Asahi
message: 「Are you training at such an hour?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Yeah, that’s right.」
A curt, affirmative response. Her eyes alone seemed to say, "You too?"

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems you were doing some very intense training.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? You watching me?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I can tell by looking at your current state.」
She was drenched in sweat, walking slowly as a cool-down. She was the same as me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...If you’re aiming to be a Toujinegi, this much is normal, right? I don't want to be lumped in with all the half-baked people around here.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think so too.」
She steals a glance at me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「You’re serious about this, too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, because I am aiming to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, is that so.」
Our eyes meet. We acknowledge each other. It’s as if we're standing before a duel.
But it only lasts for a second.

name: Sonomi
message: 「See you at the Martial Festival then.」
She turns on her heel and disappears into the dormitory.
It was the same. There is someone out there who is working just as hard as I am. Somehow, I felt saved.

name: Asahi
message: 「I might... end up fighting her, too.」
No matter who the opponent is, I don’t intend to take a single step back. In the match, I’ll just give it my all.
What the outcome will be, no one knows. But I felt that only tonight's efforts truly know.
